name: dsh-open-in-app
description: Open In: the pack's own cross-platform file-browser launcher for the vn-harness Web GUI. Forks the shipped @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app browser bundle so the File Explorer / Finder / Files menu entries post to a route this package owns, which opens the OS's file browser directly (explorer.exe, open, xdg-open, WSL-aware) instead of the shell's open verb. Alpha.
